items.description: President Trump announced the truce last month, but Israel and Hezbollah have continued to exchange fire since then.

items.title: 'We don't know if we'll make it back alive': Israel targets Lebanese rescue workers despite ceasefire
items.description: Two civil defense rescue workers were killed by an Israeli airstrike in front of their station in southern Lebanon on Tuesday. More than 110 Lebanese healthcare workers have been killed over two and half months of bombings, including 12 since mid-April, when a supposed ceasefire was declared.

items.title: 'The Strike Hit Right Above Us': A Night Under Russian Bombs In Dobropillya
items.description: Russia is preparing to assault the city of Dobropillya, according to Ukraine’s military. Located a few kilometers from the front line, the city is burning and being destroyed by bombs, artillery, and drones. Despite daily shelling, some civilians flatly refuse to leave and remain in Dobropillya.

items.title: Death toll in attack on Kyiv apartment building now stands at 24
items.description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy led an official day of mourning in Kyiv a day after a Russian cruise missile flattened an apartment building. It was one of the deadliest attacks on the capital in the 4-year-old war.

items.title: Will Ukraine corruption scandal reach Volodymyr Zelenskyy?
items.description: A drawn-out corruption affair in Ukraine has widened, with authorities now taking action against Andriy Yermak, former head of the presidential office. Will the scandal reach all the way to President Volodymyr Zelenskyy?

items.title: Kremlin Rejects EU Mediation in Ukraine Peace Talks
